title: HOKA UTMB Mont-Blanc — Race Regulations: personal assistant rules
claims: Each participant is allowed one Personal Assistant at certain aid stations, who must meet the runner at the designated aid station and leave after it.
Outside the designated aid-station zones, no one is authorised to give assistance; only the runner's own Personal Assistant is permitted to meet them.
Medical or other assistance provided by the Personal Assistant outside the permitted area may be treated as a breach under the regulation penalty table.
